facts.business: Capital Trust Limited is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) primarily engaged in lending activities, including microfinance, MSME loans, and a newly launched gold loan product, with a focus on rural and semi-urban markets.
key_risks: Concentration of advances and exposures to top borrowers
Regulatory and compliance risks in lending business
Dependence on gold price movements for gold loan portfolio
Undisputed statutory dues outstanding for more than six months
facts.related_party_note: No transactions with respect to loan, investment, guarantee and security covered under section 185 and 186 of the Companies Act, 2013 during the year.
